title: nixos/nvidia-container-toolkit: allow to provide CSV files
reason: Real new mkOptions discovery-mode and csv-files added, plus a real new assertion linking them; rest is a cosmetic reorder of suppressNvidiaDriverAssertion/device-name-strategy plus internal function-arg renames in cdi-generate.nix (deviceNameStrategy -> device-name-strategy etc, not NixOS options).

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: NEW STRUCTURAL GAP CANDIDATE: total non-discovery of the REAL hardware.nvidia-container-toolkit.* options at both base and head ('unchanged'), but with a striking symptom -- discovered_options instead returns 3 entries (hostPath, containerPath, mountOptions) that belong to a completely unrelated LOCALLY-SCOPED helper submodule ('mountType', defined in a `let` block used only for the 'mounts' option's element type), not to the real top-level options at all. Root cause: the module's `options = let mountType = {...}; in { hardware.nvidia-container-toolkit = {...}; };` wraps the entire options attrset in a `let ... in {}` expression rather than a bare attrset literal -- the walker appears to misattribute the `let`-bound helper's own fields as if they were the target options. Naming this candidate_capability_gap: options-value-wrapped-in-let-binding causes total non-discovery with spurious substitution of an unrelated local helper's fields. First instance this round; distinct from all previously catalogued gap shapes.
